about: The releases of Orkboard, newest first: what an installed copy reads to update itself (docs/updates.md). A release marked critical installs by itself when Orkboard opens; one marked major (or starting a later line, 0.1 → 0.2) is offered louder in the window.

releases.notes: Orkboard on its own: the Board with its parties and goals, the preview, Agents and Review, on the desktop and on a paired phone.
